_note: NEW text at v2026-08-25 within the (otherwise pre-existing, 04-08) Replay Protection section of signatures.md: the mismatched-payload-on-duplicate-key rule, the payload-matching mechanism (Content-Digest/SHA-256), and the platform's fresh-key-on-payload-change obligation. Scope deliberately narrow per the mission instruction ('the idempotency/replay text AS RELEASED, not our pending #782') -- the much larger surrounding signatures.md rewrite (EdDSA/Ed25519 support, WBA dual-audience signatures, JWK OKP shape, key-rotation wording) is NOT extracted here; it is a distinct, large new-normative-surface area outside this mission's named target list. rows.requirement: On a duplicate Idempotency-Key request whose payload does NOT match the original, the business MUST reject with 409 Conflict (REST) / -32000 (MCP) and MUST NOT execute the request
rows.quote: | **On duplicate (mismatched payload)** | Reject with `409 Conflict` (REST) / `-32000` (MCP); do not execute |
rows.notes: NEW at 08-25: the 04-08 Idempotency Key Requirements table had a single 'On duplicate' row ('Return cached response, do not re-execute') with no mismatched-payload case. 08-25 splits it into matching-payload (unchanged behavior) and mismatched-payload (new: reject) rows.

rows.requirement: Businesses MUST detect whether a duplicate-key request's payload matches the original by comparing the SHA-256 hash of the raw body bytes (the same digest RFC 9530 mandates as Content-Digest)
rows.quote:
Businesses **MUST** detect whether the payload of
a duplicate-key request matches the payload of the original by
comparing the SHA-256 hash of the raw body bytes
rows.notes: New 'Payload Matching' paragraph. For signed requests the value is the Content-Digest header (persisted alongside the idempotency key); for unsigned requests the business computes the same digest from the received body bytes.

rows.requirement: Platforms MUST generate a fresh idempotency key whenever they modify the request payload, including retries with modified payment instruments, updated shipping addresses, swapped line items, or any other change to the request body
rows.quote:
Platforms
therefore **MUST** generate a fresh idempotency key whenever they
modify the request payload — including retries with modified payment
instruments, updated shipping addresses, swapped line items, or any
other change to the request body.
rows.notes: NEW explicit platform-side obligation; directly checkable end-to-end by reusing an idempotency key with a changed body and confirming REPLAY-001's rejection (409/-32000) rather than either the original or a silently-updated response.
